Method of Attack: ransomware attack involving partial encryption of IT systems and files, data theft, and blackmailing with threats to leak stolen data
Discoverer: German Federal Office for Information Security (Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik)
Impacted Systems: Semikron company network and IT systems
Attack Vector: cyber attack by a professional hacker group targeting company network
Indicators of Compromise: ransom note indicating 2TB worth of documents stolen
